proposals.evidence: DEDR3754 gives Tamil nilavu/nilā, Malayalam nilāvu/lāvu, Kodagu nelaci, Telugu nela, Gadaba neliŋ and Gondi nalenj/nelenj/lēnj moon. Selected nilav/nelavu/lāvu/nelaci and nella/nelli survey responses are comparative variants retaining the moon sense and source consonant reductions; no Indo-Aryan candra forms are included. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2599 gives Tamil cīvu to sweep clean and Malayalam cūl broom, beside cīprā/cīpari broom. Survey cīva/cīval/civil/cīvalu-type broom nouns are proposed southern lect extensions of the sweep/broom family with ordinary nominal endings and source vowels retained. Longer bundle compounds are analysed separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1931 gives Tamil cem-/civa- red with past -nt-, Malayalam cem-/covva/cuvappu/cōppu red, and Kannada kempu. These selected southern covatta/cuvanda/cem-/cemappu-type survey responses preserve the documented colour family with lect vowels, nasal/labial developments and ordinary adjective endings. Kannada c-initial loan-looking forms are excluded from this group. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
